notes: Fiscal year 2026 ended January 25, 2026. Sources: FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001045810-26-000021, filed February 25, 2026) and the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A, accession 0001045810-26-000036, filed May 12, 2026), ownership as of March 23, 2026, on 24,312,141,810 shares outstanding. Huang's 870,604,104 shares include family trusts and LLCs, plus 58,683,830 shares held by The Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation, of which he and his wife are board members. The proxy names him Jen-Hsun Huang. BLACKROCK's percentage is stale: the proxy bases it solely on a Schedule 13G/A reporting holdings as of December 31, 2023 (split-adjusted for the June 2024 ten-for-one split), divided by the March 2026 share count; Vanguard's is from a Schedule 13G filed by Vanguard Capital Management reporting holdings at March 31, 2026. STOCK COMP is the cash-flow add-back ($6,386m). GEOGRAPHY: in the third quarter of fiscal 2026 NVIDIA changed its geographic basis from customer billing location to customer headquarters location and recast prior periods, so Singapore no longer appears; the 10-K estimates 76% of Data Center revenue from Taiwan-headquartered customers was attributed to end customers in the United States and Europe. Segment values rounded from millions; they sum to 215.95 against a stated total of 215.94. ROLE: after the fiscal year, NVIDIA's 8-K of November 12, 2026 reported that the Board accepted Huang's resignation as President, CEO and director on November 11, 2026, and its 8-K of November 23, 2026 reported that the Board reinstated him in all three roles on November 22, 2026.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended January 25, 2026 (FY2026 Form 10-K, accession 0001045810-26-000021). Capex is reported as one combined property, equipment and intangible assets line. The $13,000 million paid for Groq, Inc. and $1,535 million of acquisitions are investing outflows for businesses and assets acquired, not capex, and are excluded. Taxes paid are inside operating cash flow; interest paid is no longer disclosed (see inputs.interestPaid).

marketcap.notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as NVDA. The latest 10-Q (quarter ended July 26, 2026; no later 10-Q was on EDGAR at the time of research) gives 24,147 million shares outstanding at quarter end in its statement of shareholders' equity, stated in millions; shares = 24,147 × 1,000,000. Its cover states only a rounded 24.1 billion at August 21, 2026. The 2026 proxy's precise count was 24,312,141,810 at March 23, 2026, older and since reduced by buybacks.

pay.notes: Employees: approximate count at the end of fiscal 2026 (January 25, 2026), from the FY2026 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median is used; it is for fiscal 2026, the same year as the head count. NVIDIA reused the median employee identified for fiscal 2024, stating there were no changes to its employee population or compensation arrangements that would significantly affect the disclosure.
